sample_representation: all 2085 frozen evaluation genes in log1p(CP10K), without PCA compression
training_cells: all train and permitted vehicle controls in frozen split_v1
optimizer: AdamW with gradient norm clipping at 5
prediction_rep_mix: frozen measured replicate cell-count proportions, using metadata only
prediction_postprocessing: clip negative predicted log-expression to zero; no renormalization or rounding
auxiliary_loss_scale: weight multiplied by update frequency so expected auxiliary coefficient equals the named weight
fraction_loss_definition: Mean squared difference of real and generated soft fractions over training_taus.
mmd_loss_definition: unbiased three-bandwidth RBF MMD squared in the frozen evaluation PCA space
hyperparameter_selection: seed 0 validation only; repeat the selected WRF and MMD settings with seeds 1 and 2
auxiliary_precision: float64 trajectory and response score; float32 base loss, parameters and optimizer
